hypothesis: Training-only bijective identity variation and rare-state sampling reduce memorized identity/layout associations; this combined engineering revision does not isolate causal effects of either ingredient.
identity_augmentation: Bijective equal-length worker-ID rename throughout complete training observation only; labels/evidence offsets remain unchanged; no new validation/held-out examples or formats.
sampling: Maximum inverse-square-root training count across the four structured labels, normalized across training observations.
checkpoint_selection: All families admitted first, then fewest false ON, worst-family field accuracy, worst-family recall, worst-family evidence overlap, higher threshold.
